message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal charge(s). Facts: dispute over land foundation rights, defendant beat victim with iron pipe, causing injuries: multiple soft tissue contusions, left fibula fracture, injury classified as light injury. He voluntarily surrendered and confessed.

This is a case of intentional injury (故意伤害). Chinese criminal law: causing bodily injury, classified as light injury => still intentional injury crime. So charge: 故意伤害. Also possibly assault? In Chinese law, the crime is "故意伤害罪". The rule says when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "故意伤害". No other crimes. No fraud. So final answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.
